clue.text: Sleeping accommodation one has down under

definitions.text: Sleeping accommodation one has down under

parts.words: Sleeping accommodation one has down under
parts.note: a mattress stuffed with soft feathers lies beneath the sleeper, so the down is literally under you, while 'down under' tempts a reading of Australia

explanation.surface: A traveller describes where they slept in Australia.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Down under' looks like Australia; here it is the soft plumage stuffing a mattress that lies beneath the sleeper.
explanation.definitionFit: A bed or mattress stuffed with plumage is a soft sleeping place.

clue.text: Joint needing oil and vigorous rubbing

parts.note: the elbow is a joint of the arm
grease is an oily lubricant

explanation.surface: A stiff joint needs lubricating and a good massage.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means hard physical effort, especially in scrubbing or polishing.

clue.text: Legal document named to take possession of river

indicators.note: to take possession of something is to hold it, so one piece holds the other

parts.note: titled means named
the Dee is a river in Scotland and in Wales

explanation.surface: A deed naming the owner of a stretch of river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to take possession of' signals that the first piece holds the second; the Dee flows through Wales, Chester and Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: A deed proves legal ownership of property.

clue.text: Sweetheart became invalid and passed away

parts.note: read as sweet's heart: the central letter of the word sweet
a policy or licence lapses when it is no longer valid

explanation.surface: A lover fell ill and died.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sweetheart' looks like a lover; read it as the heart of 'sweet', its middle letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Time that has gone by has slipped away.

clue.text: Coup by Red admiral, say, that makes use of arms at the front

definitions.text: that makes use of arms at the front

indicators.note: by means beside, so one piece is set next to the other

parts.note: the red admiral is an example of a butterfly
a coup is a stroke, as in a stroke of genius

explanation.surface: A naval officer's coup using firepower at the front line.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Red admiral' reads as a communist naval officer; it is a butterfly.
explanation.definitionFit: In this swimming style both arms sweep forward together in front of the swimmer.

clue.text: Behaving with good taste, accepting furnishing style with hesitation

parts.note: decor is the style of a room's furnishing
um is a sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: Tastefully accepting a room's furnishings while dithering.
explanation.definitionFit: Propriety means seemly conduct and good manners.

clue.text: Name of person regretfully not dining, out of egotism — she was missed

definitions.text: Name of person regretfully not dining

indicators.note: the name is drawn out of the letters of the word egotism

explanation.surface: A self-absorbed guest's absence from dinner went unmourned.
explanation.walkthrough: The Cole Porter song 'Miss Otis Regrets' has her unable to lunch today; 'she was missed' plays on her title Miss.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Cole Porter song the lady sends regrets that she cannot lunch, so she is a person regretfully not dining.

clue.text: Indian male among weaker batsmen

indicators.note: one piece goes among the letters of the other

parts.note: in cricket the tail is the weaker batsmen at the end of the batting order

explanation.surface: An Indian man is in the lower batting order.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the tail is the less able batsmen who bat last.
explanation.definitionFit: A people of southern India and Sri Lanka, and their language.

clue.text: Church body's gesture supporting disheartened society

indicators.note: in a down clue the supporting piece sits below the other
a disheartened word has lost its heart, leaving only its outer letters

parts.note: a nod is a gesture

explanation.surface: Church leaders give a nod to a dispirited community.
explanation.definitionFit: A church council of clergy and lay members.

clue.text: Steal a work of art

definitions.meaning: to remove or purloin something, a formal sense of taking away

explanation.definitionFit: The verb can mean to take away or purloin, and the noun is a non-figurative artwork.

clue.text: Frequent public recreational area

definitions.meaning: an open grassy space in a town shared by everyone, like a village green

explanation.walkthrough: In Britain an open public green in a town or village, such as Clapham's, is called by this name.
explanation.definitionFit: Something often met is ordinary; a shared open green in a British town is also called by this word.

clue.text: On board, cry for oars

indicators.note: being on a ship means sitting inside it, so one piece goes within the ship's letters

parts.note: go on board a ship: SS, short for steamship
to cry is to weep

explanation.surface: A sailor on deck shouts an order for the rowing gear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On' works as a container signal: aboard a ship you are in it. Long heavy oars on old galleys and barges went by this name.
explanation.definitionFit: Long oars used on galleys and barges were known by this term.

clue.text: Made a member go around in dire need

indicators.note: one piece is placed inside the other
dire means dreadful, so the letters of need are in a bad, disordered state

parts.note: to roll is to go around, as a wheel turns

explanation.surface: Someone joined a club after making the rounds in desperate want.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dire' signals the scramble giving ENED; 'in' puts the other piece inside that, splitting it after EN.
explanation.definitionFit: To be signed up on a register makes one a member of a group.

clue.text: Renew most of the area destroyed in China

indicators.note: destroyed means wrecked, so the letters are thrown into a new arrangement
most of the phrase is used, one letter being dropped

explanation.surface: Rebuild nearly all the ruined region in China.
explanation.walkthrough: 'most of' drops an E from THE AREA to leave THARA; with RENEW 'destroyed' scrambles all eleven letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Here china means pottery, and this word is a type of clay pottery.

clue.text: Deliver without charge.

explanation.definitionFit: To liberate someone is to deliver them; costing nothing is gratis.

clue.text: Series of notes of passionate nature injurious to reputation

parts.note: D, E and F are a run of consecutive musical notes
amatory means relating to sexual love or passion

explanation.surface: A run of love letters proves damaging to someone's good name.
explanation.definitionFit: Libel and slander are speech that harms a person's good name.

clue.text: Step on it to maintain the circulation

definitions.text: Step on it to maintain the circulation

parts.words: Step on it to maintain the circulation
parts.note: a machine you walk on keeps your blood flowing, and 'step on it' also suggests hurrying

explanation.surface: Advice to hurry and keep the blood flowing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Step on it' looks like 'hurry up'; it means literally treading on an exercise machine.
explanation.definitionFit: This is an exercise machine with a moving belt that you walk on.

clue.text: Eccentric actress such as West?

parts.note: a card is an eccentric or amusing person
a player is an actor or actress

explanation.surface: An offbeat film star like Mae West is described.
explanation.walkthrough: 'West' looks like Mae West the actress, but it is one of the four seats at a bridge table, so the question mark marks a definition by example.
explanation.definitionFit: At bridge the four participants are named North, South, East and West.

clue.text: Amount of light music he composed

definitions.meaning: a unit of luminance in physics
an English composer, first name Constant, who wrote The Rio Grande

explanation.definitionFit: It is both a unit measuring brightness and the surname of the English composer Constant.

clue.text: Dried fruit is put in lots of water

indicators.note: the word is is put in the other piece

parts.note: rains are heavy falls of water

explanation.surface: Fruit is soaked in plenty of water.
explanation.definitionFit: These are dried grapes.

clue.text: Genuine article returned with note inside

indicators.note: the note is placed inside the other piece
returned means the word for the article is read backwards

parts.note: the is the definite article
C is a musical note

explanation.surface: Authentic goods are sent back with a covering letter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returned' turns THE into EHT; C goes inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A German loanword meaning authentic, real.

clue.text: Perfume producer needs time to end disastrous embargo

indicators.note: the time piece comes at the end of the rest
a disastrous embargo is wrecked, so its letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A scent maker needs time to finish a ruinous trade ban.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disastrous' rearranges the ban's letters into BERGAMO, and 'to end' places the time abbreviation after them; bergamot is the citrus whose oil scents Earl Grey.
explanation.definitionFit: This citrus tree yields an aromatic oil used in scents and in Earl Grey tea.

clue.text: Young woman left scene of noisy confusion

parts.note: a babe is an attractive young woman

explanation.surface: A girl walked out on a noisy chaotic scene.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical tower where languages were confounded gave a word for din and confusion.

clue.text: Sport for mischievous child

definitions.meaning: in biology a sport is a variant or mutation differing from its type

explanation.definitionFit: A plant differing from its type is a variant or sport; a playful scamp is also called this.

clue.text: Order during a depression

parts.note: in means during, as in 'in the night'
a dent is a hollow or depression

explanation.surface: A command is given in the middle of an economic slump.
explanation.definitionFit: In commerce this is an official requisition for goods.

clue.text: Ask for ace and beat it!

parts.note: to beg is to ask for
an ace counts as one in cards

explanation.surface: A card player requests an ace and then is told to clear off.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are commands telling someone to go away.

clue.text: Inspiration for character in novel

definitions.meaning: the real person on whom a fictional figure is based

explanation.definitionFit: The real model for a fictional figure is its prototype; something new and fresh is unprecedented.

clue.text: Spot line, turning over sediment in port

indicators.note: turning over means the two pieces together are read backwards

parts.note: to spot is to see

explanation.surface: Someone notices a mark while turning a bottle of wine over.
explanation.definitionFit: Dregs settle at the bottom of a bottle of fortified wine.

clue.text: People who are this are natural actors

definitions.text: People who are this are natural actors

parts.words: People who are this are natural actors
parts.note: people who act naturally are simply being who they are, not playing a role

explanation.surface: A remark about born performers on stage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Natural actors' suggests born talents of the stage; it means people behaving naturally, playing no part.
explanation.definitionFit: Behaving naturally means being one's own selves, with no pretence.
